title: PartnerTreeView Overview Tour
description: Partner tree node detail navigation interface with tabs for managing specific organizational hierarchy nodes. Provides organized access to partner tree details and analytics data.

popover.title: Welcome to PartnerTreeViewComponent
popover.description: This page serves as the central hub for viewing and managing the details of a specific organizational node within the partner hierarchy. It provides a comprehensive overview, allowing users to navigate through different aspects of the node, such as its core details, relationships, and associated analytics.

popover.title: Edit
popover.description:
Opens a dialog to modify the details of the current organizational node, including its name, properties, and hierarchical position within the partner tree.

When to use: When you need to modify organizational node details, relationships, or hierarchical positioning

popover.title: Tour Complete!
popover.description: You've learned the key features of PartnerTreeView. You can always restart this tour from the help menu.
